subject: history
concept: Locating your own country and a few other countries on a world map
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student places a marker on their own country on a physical or virtual map
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a country's shape/flag to its correct location on a map
exercise.abstract: Student describes the general location of a named country relative to their own

misconception_flags: confuses a country with its continent or a neighboring country

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
